title: Resolution to limit property tax class shift for 2027
summary: This resolution caps the year-over-year increase in each property class's share of the citywide tax levy at 0.3 percent for Fiscal 2027, instead of the usual 5 percent cap under state law. Without this change, state formulas would have raised the tax rate for class one homeowners by 5.4 percent compared to Fiscal 2026. The Council must make this determination by December 1, 2026 under a 2026 state law change.
